write_up: Your resume points toward desktop support: you worked on school help desk tickets and classroom laptops after helping electronics customers. It's common for early-career resumes to list the tasks without much detail, but that makes it tough to stand out in a pile. A recruiter may finish this one and move on with questions about the work and the time since your internship.

The Active Directory line is your best model because it names both the task and the tool. Your A.A.S. and CompTIA A+ are relevant, but your education sits above your work experience, and nothing accounts for the time after May 2025.

Let's start with the Chattahoochee County Schools internship. Add the kinds of issues you handled and how many laptops you set up, if you can confirm those details. Then account for the time since the internship honestly and move Experience above Education.
